qualifications: Strictly private supplied-cut computation. Full census/rule truth and denied identities must remain internal host/owner data and must not be exposed as ordinary query output or diagnostics.

Input framing permits at most 4,194,304 UTF8 bytes; the unchanged parser additionally permits at most 4,000,000 UTF16 code units, depth128 and 100,000 values. The stricter parser bound can refuse an otherwise frame-sized request. Producer bounds remain additional constraints.

The child has no internal wall-clock watchdog and waits for EOF after responding. Empty or initialization-only EOF may exit0 without an evaluation. A malformed third frame can cause exit2 after a previously complete valid reply; it does not retract earlier bytes. Host must enforce exact expected replies, one evaluation, deadline and cleanup; exit0 or acknowledgement is not authority.

The new initialization frame includes version/fixed owner/selection and omits the old extensionSelection envelope. Its framed SHA differs from Truss native registration source_receipt. Retain original registration receipt and compose the new initializer from exact registered originals plus prepared projection; never equate/substitute the hashes or treat either as authenticated authority.
